name: robots/caelan__ltamp
title: LTAMP simulated PR2 (PyBullet PBController)
intro: LTAMP simulated PR2 (PyBullet PBController), adapted from caelan/ltamp. It reads `joint_positions`; sets `torso_position`; runs `move_arms`. `move_arms`: command one or more actuated joints to target positions in joint space, optionally over a declared duration, and report whether the target was reached within tolerance. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/caelan__ltamp --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/caelan__ltamp --backend fake --mcp
